headword: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}

definitions.explanation: Technology that overlays digital information — such as images, text, or 3D models — onto the real-world environment, typically viewed through a smartphone, tablet, or special glasses.

examples.japanese: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}のアプリを{使|つか}ってみた。
examples.english: I tried using an augmented reality app.

examples.japanese: {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{教育|きょういく}{分野|ぶんや}でも{活用|かつよう}されている。
examples.english: Augmented reality technology is also being used in the field of education.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンのカメラを{通|とお}して{拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}の{世界|せかい}を{体験|たいけん}できる。
examples.english: You can experience the world of augmented reality through your smartphone's camera.

notes:
A compound of {拡張|かくちょう} (expansion, augmentation) + {現実|げんじつ} (reality). Often abbreviated as AR in both Japanese and English contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: AR technology
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}アプリ: AR application
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}を{体験|たいけん}する: to experience augmented reality
- {拡張現実|かくちょうげんじつ}{対応|たいおう}: AR-compatible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- VR（{仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}）: virtual reality — creates an entirely artificial environment, unlike AR which overlays digital content on the real world
- MR（{複合現実|ふくごうげんじつ}）: mixed reality — blends real and virtual worlds more seamlessly than AR
- XR: extended reality — an umbrella term covering AR, VR, and MR
